rows.advertised: 10 cards at 1,150 USD each
rows.outcome: 10 cards arrived very nicely packaged, unlocked and modded at no extra charge, with no issues so far. The price had risen to 1,400 USD by the time they shipped a few days later, but the original price was honoured. The capacitor rework was very clean when he opened a card.

rows.advertised: Two cards locked at 2,998 EUR including DDP shipping (1,595 USD each plus about 170 USD shipping)
rows.outcome: The price rose to 1,899 and then 2,099 per card before the cards were modded, tested or shipped, but the seller honoured the quote. The cards arrived on September 10 very well packaged, each with a free 3D-printed shroud and matching blower fan, and the seller sent a test video.

After payment the seller sent a test video without being asked. Of the 2 cards he bought, one had bad HBM: it passed a basic Vulkan test 9 times out of 10 but failed most other tests and inference gave all NaN. He got a refund through Alibaba; the second card was going strong. Of 10 cards he bought from Alibaba sellers, he called alifond the only one that was not a scam.

10 cards with no errors and fast shipping. All mods worked, including the power MOSFET work; each came with a 3D-printed cooler attachment and a cable, and the cards were very clean inside and out. He called the price crazy high.

The buyer ordered twice; the cards arrived and tested without issues. The orders were a while back.
